strings.name: Demis Hassabis
strings.summary: Hassabis connects game development, cognitive neuroscience and AI research. He co-founded DeepMind and helped advance team projects including AlphaGo and AlphaFold. He and John Jumper shared half of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein structure prediction; David Baker received the other half. In 2026 he became Google DeepMind chair and Alphabet chief scientist. His career illustrates the close links between fundamental research and large technology platforms.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 2026-11-13; the timeline includes the August 2026 role change. AlphaGo and AlphaFold are team achievements. Structure prediction does not resolve every question about protein function.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Predicting protein structures
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Advanced AlphaFold research with John Jumper; they jointly received half of the 2024 Chemistry Nobel for structure prediction.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: From games to intelligent systems
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Under his leadership, the DeepMind team developed AlphaGo, combining deep learning and search in Go.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Becomes Alphabet chief scientist
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Google announced his move to Google DeepMind chair and Alphabet chief scientist, while he continued leading Isomorphic Labs.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Receives the Chemistry Nobel
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Shared half of the prize with John Jumper for protein structure prediction; David Baker received the other half.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: AlphaFold2 breakthrough
strings.timeline.event-03.text: The team achieved a major advance in protein structure prediction assessment, supporting AI applications in life sciences.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol
strings.timeline.event-04.text: The DeepMind team's system won the five-game Go match by four games to one.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Google acquires DeepMind
strings.timeline.event-05.text: The company joined Google, providing organizational and computing resources for further large-scale AI research.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Co-founds DeepMind
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Established an AI research company with partners in London to explore general learning systems.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Completes neuroscience doctorate
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Completed doctoral research at UCL on neural mechanisms underlying episodic memory.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Born in London
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Born in London; became interested in chess, computers and game development at an early age.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded DeepMind and advanced AlphaGo and AlphaFold, connecting AI research with scientific discovery.
